evidence_location: Release evidence/step16-native-comparison and evidence/step16-native-release; original run JSON and implementation.zip are preserved unchanged.
limitations: Handwritten example rules, not an LLM comparison or evidence of general superiority.
Single uses three isolated attempts; multi uses one three-generator cohort.
Single proposal alpha .05/3 matches multi cohort Bonferroni correction.
Role-specific gates remain enabled; sampling and resource caps are identical.
One trial is an engineering demonstration, not a between-strategy significance test.
Tokens and monetary cost are unavailable; no external models are called.
method: deterministic single-generator versus multi-generator; shared safety reviewers
post_run_validation: All candidate/arm environment identities were checked equal after measurement. The frozen run implementation predates automatic cross-arm validation and source snapshot support; its implementation.zip was captured before later code changes.
